text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle pushed right through the 
poor track conditions with her trademark 
power!

Thrilled to have fired up the audience 
with her powerful running, Taiki Shuttle 
basks in a happy mood.

What she sets her sights on next are 
short-range races, even shorter than a 
mile.

To etch her "speed" into the hearts of the 
audience, she decides to enter the 
Sprinters Stakes!
